cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project("STM32_Workspace")

enable_language(C CXX ASM)

set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD 11)
set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS ON)

include("cmake/vscode_generated.cmake")

# ==============================
# COMMON CORE (startup + syscall)
# ==============================
file(GLOB FREERTOS_SRC
    ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/FreeRTOS/tasks.c
    ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/FreeRTOS/queue.c
    ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/FreeRTOS/list.c
)

file(GLOB FREERTOS_PORT
    ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/FreeRTOS/portable/GCC/ARM_CM3/port.c
)

set(FREERTOS_HEAP
    ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/FreeRTOS/portable/MemMang/heap_4.c
)

# Define
add_definitions(
    -DSTM32F103xB
)

add_library(common_core STATIC
    # ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/common/core/startup_stm32f103xx.S
    ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/common/core/syscall.c
    ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/common/core/sysmem.c
    ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/common/core/startup_stm32f103xb.s
    ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/Drivers/CMSIS/system_stm32f1xx.c
    ${FREERTOS_SRC}
    ${FREERTOS_PORT}
    ${FREERTOS_HEAP}
)

target_include_directories(common_core PUBLIC
    ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/FreeRTOS/include
    ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/FreeRTOS/portable/GCC/ARM_CM3
    ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/Drivers/CMSIS/Core/Include
    ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/Drivers/CMSIS/Device/ST/STM32F1xx/Include
)

set_source_files_properties(
    ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/common/core/startup_stm32f103xx.S
    PROPERTIES LANGUAGE ASM
)

target_compile_options(common_core PRIVATE
    -mcpu=cortex-m3
    -mthumb
    -fdata-sections
    -ffunction-sections
)

# ==============================
# GLOBAL SETTINGS (STM32 style)
# ==============================
add_library(stm32_base_settings INTERFACE)

target_compile_options(stm32_base_settings INTERFACE
    -mcpu=cortex-m3
    -mthumb
    -fdata-sections
    -ffunction-sections

    -Wall
    -Wextra
    -Wpedantic
    -Wno-unused-parameter

    $<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:ASM>:-x assembler-with-cpp -MMD -MP>

    $<$<CONFIG:Debug>:-O0 -g3>
    $<$<CONFIG:Release>:-Os>
)

# ==============================
# LINK SETTINGS (QUAN TRỌNG)
# ==============================
target_link_options(stm32_base_settings INTERFACE
    -mcpu=cortex-m3
    -mthumb

    --specs=nano.specs

    -Wl,--gc-sections
    -Wl,--print-memory-usage

    -Wl,--start-group
    -lc
    -lm
    -Wl,--end-group

    -u _printf_float
)
